description: BRCA1 (breast cancer type 1 susceptibility protein) domain-structure set: gene, MANE Select transcript, sequences, UniProt P38398, the C61G substitution, PDB 1JM7 (the RING-domain heterodimer with BARD1, solution NMR) and its residue mapping; the structure covers a domain, never the whole protein.

bridgeQuestion: See the C61G mutation on the protein.
notes: Phase 9 P9.2.2 (docs/phase-9-generalisation.md section 13). HGNC:1100. The variant is the substitution C61G, dbSNP rs28897672, a multi-allelic site (A/C/G/T on the forward strand): the gene is on the reverse strand, so c.181T>G is A>C on the forward strand and the forward allele is C, read from the variant recoder's allele key (as HBB's c.20A>T is forward allele A) and confirmed by VEP; every position, codon and residue in the records is read back from the responses. The ClinVar uid 17661 is the VCV000017661 record (c.181T>G, p.Cys61Gly), confirmed from the live esearch of 2026-11-03, which returned three uids for the rsID: 17661 and the records of the other two alleles (54359 c.181T>A, 54360 c.181T>C), kept separate. Structure: the four UniProt PDB cross-references whose chains cover residue 61 were checked in order on 2026-11-03 with scripts/data-preparation/check-structure-candidates.ts --uniprot P38398 --residue 61 --entries 1JM7,7JZV,7LYB,8GRQ (report research/derived/structure-candidates-P38398-61.json). 1JM7 (solution NMR, no resolution, 14 models in atom_site of 25 calculated, representative conformer 2 by the depositors' criterion; the BRCA1/BARD1 RING-domain heterodimer) observes residue 61 on chain A as CYS (label and auth 61) in model 1 and its entity equals UniProt over the SIFTS-mapped segment 1 to 110; the two residues beyond it (111, 112) are a cloning artifact by the entry's own _struct_ref_seq_dif and are outside the mapping, so 1JM7 is taken under structurePreference variant-residue-observed. It covers residues 1 to 103 of 1,863 (103 observed positions, 5.5 %; residues 104 to 112 have no coordinates), and its second polymer entity is BARD1, UniProt Q99728 by the entry's _struct_ref, chain B. The other candidates all observe residue 61: 7JZV (cryo-EM, 3.9 A) is a fusion construct that declares pdbx_mutation UbcH5c C85K, which the builder refuses; 7LYB (3.28 A) and 8GRQ (3.87 A) are nucleosome complexes that equal UniProt over their mapped segments and would be taken had 1JM7 failed. Model 1 is the model every mapping, contact and view uses; the structure record states the ensemble size and the representative conformer so that a reader knows model 1 is not the depositors' representative one. The structure shows the wild-type residue at position 61 in a domain; the mutant protein is never shown and no predicted model stands in for the 1,760 residues the entry does not cover.
